major_cooldowns.name: Deathmark
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use on cooldown when Garrote and Rupture are active, ideally with Kingsbane.

major_cooldowns.name: Kingsbane
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use on cooldown immediately after Deathmark, or when Envenom is up.

major_cooldowns.name: Vanish
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use offensively to apply Improved Garrote, lining up with Deathmark.

defensives.name: Cloak of Shadows
defensives.usage_rule: Use to clear and immune magic effects.

defensives.name: Feint
defensives.usage_rule: Use preemptively to reduce incoming AoE damage.

rules.action: Always cast Kingsbane immediately after Deathmark when both are available.
Use Vanish exclusively to apply Improved Garrote, ideally synced with Deathmark.
Cast Envenom or Rupture at 5 or more combo points, never overcap.
Ensure Garrote and Rupture are ticking before casting Deathmark.

source_summary: Assassination Rogue relies on careful energy and combo point management, prioritizing bleed uptime (Garrote, Rupture) before executing burst windows. Deathmark, Kingsbane, and Vanish (for Improved Garrote) form the core cooldown trio, cast together for massive damage.
